waybackify search [flags] <original-url>

CDX capture query — re-pick a better capture

CDX capture query (the library's getSnapshot/getSnapshots face) — for
re-picking a better capture when check flags one bad. No
date-anchoring cleverness: --near passes through, default is
CDX's own ordering.

--match, --from, or --to switch to ENUMERATION: every capture under
a host, domain, or prefix, paged, with a long backoff while the
index is offline. An outage fails the command (exit 1); it is never
read as "no captures".

Output: JSONL, {timestamp, statuscode, mimetype, waybackUrl} per
capture; enumeration adds {original, digest, length, urlkey}.

Arguments:
  <original-url>   the archived-site URL (or host, domain, prefix) to query captures of

Flags:
  --near <ts>      preferred timestamp (YYYYMMDD[HHMMSS]); passed through to CDX
  --limit <n>      maximum captures to emit
  --match <type>   enumerate: exact | prefix | host | domain
  --from <ts>      enumerate: window start (1–14 digits)
  --to <ts>        enumerate: window end (1–14 digits)
  --help|-h        Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
